title: Enterprise Connectivity: statutory debit computation
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this statutory debit computation rule to separate statutory tax.

## Basis: outcome
For separate statutory tax, multiply that rounded issued-net base by the selected tax rate and round only the final tax component half-up to the source-tier monetary precision; zero-rate sources have no tax debit. Post exactly one positive upward adjustment with net service subtotal zero, tax component equal to amount, and source classification supplemental, linked to the original net invoice. This separately identified statutory tax addition is not a correction of an erroneous invoice.

## Basis Q&A
| Separate statutory tax basis | Consequence for this action |
| --- | --- |
| Separate statutory tax: Multiply that rounded issued-net base by the selected tax rate and round only the final tax component half-up to the source-tier monetary precision | zero-rate sources have no tax debit. Post exactly one positive upward adjustment with net service subtotal zero, tax component equal to amount, and source classification supplemental, linked to the original net invoice. This separately identified statutory tax addition is not a correction of an erroneous invoice. |

## Hypothetical calculation
For a hypothetical rounded issued-net amount of USD 12.34, tax fraction of 0.07 and two-decimal precision, the tax component is USD 0.86 after final half-up rounding of USD 0.8638. The net component of this distinct debit remains zero.
